name: @w6w-apps/airparser
description: Parse emails and documents (PDF, DOCX, images, and more) into structured JSON with Airparser's AI extraction.

w6w.longDescription:
Airparser parses emails and documents — PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, HTML, images and more — into structured JSON using an AI extraction schema you define once per inbox. This app covers the whole documented lifecycle: upload a document synchronously and get the parsed JSON back in the same call, or upload asynchronously and fetch the result once background parsing finishes; read a single parsed document or its extended details; list an inbox's documents with date, status and search filters; and manage inboxes and their extraction schemas, including cloning a schema from one inbox to another.

If an inbox has no extraction schema yet, Airparser generates one automatically from the first document you upload — there is nothing to configure before the first parse.

A health check tracks Airparser's own status page; Airparser publishes no account-level credit or rate-limit endpoint, so quota headroom is declared unavailable rather than guessed.
